<h2 id="1-引言">1. 引言</h2>
<p>本教程介绍 Vulkan 中的 Cooperative Matrix（协作矩阵）技术，包括工作原理、Vulkan 扩展 API、Shader 函数详解，以及在 NCNN 深度学习框架中的实际应用。</p>

<h2 id="2-矩阵分块基础">2. 矩阵分块基础</h2>
<p>在深入学习 Cooperative Matrix 之前，理解<strong>矩阵分块（Matrix Tiling/Blocking）</strong>是必要的。矩阵分块是高性能矩阵计算的核心技术，也是 Cooperative Matrix 的工作基础。</p>
<h3 id="21-为什么需要矩阵分块">2.1 为什么需要矩阵分块</h3>
<h4 id="大矩阵计算的挑战">大矩阵计算的挑战</h4>
<p>考虑两个大矩阵相乘：<span class="math inline">\(C = A \times B\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(4096 \times 4096\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(4096 \times 4096\)</span>。</p>
<p><strong>计算量</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{FLOP} = 2 \times 4096 \times 4096 \times 4096 \approx 137 \text{ GFLOP}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>内存访问量</strong>（朴素实现）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{读取 A} = 4096 \times 4096 \times 4 \text{ bytes} \times 4096 = 256 \text{ GB}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{读取 B} = 4096 \times 4096 \times 4 \text{ bytes} \times 4096 = 256 \text{ GB}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{写入 C} = 4096 \times 4096 \times 4 \text{ bytes} = 64 \text{ MB}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>朴素实现中，每个输出元素 <span class="math inline">\(C_{ij}\)</span> 需要读取 A 的一整行和 B 的一整列，导致大量重复的内存访问。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="分块解决方案">分块解决方案</h4>
<p>将大矩阵划分为小块，每次只处理一个小块：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[A = \begin{bmatrix}
A_{00} &amp; A_{01} &amp; \cdots &amp; A_{0,k-1} \\
A_{10} &amp; A_{11} &amp; \cdots &amp; A_{1,k-1} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
A_{m-1,0} &amp; A_{m-1,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; A_{m-1,k-1}
\end{bmatrix}, \quad
B = \begin{bmatrix}
B_{00} &amp; B_{01} &amp; \cdots &amp; B_{0,n-1} \\
B_{10} &amp; B_{11} &amp; \cdots &amp; B_{1,n-1} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
B_{k-1,0} &amp; B_{k-1,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; B_{k-1,n-1}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>分块矩阵乘法</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[C_{ij} = \sum_{l=0}^{k-1} A_{il} \times B_{lj}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>分块示意</strong>（以 <span class="math inline">\(128 \times 128\)</span> 矩阵，<span class="math inline">\(16 \times 16\)</span> 分块为例）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[A = \begin{bmatrix}
\boxed{A_{00}} &amp; \boxed{A_{01}} &amp; \boxed{A_{02}} &amp; \boxed{A_{03}} \\
\boxed{A_{10}} &amp; \boxed{A_{11}} &amp; \boxed{A_{12}} &amp; \boxed{A_{13}} \\
\boxed{A_{20}} &amp; \boxed{A_{21}} &amp; \boxed{A_{22}} &amp; \boxed{A_{23}} \\
\boxed{A_{30}} &amp; \boxed{A_{31}} &amp; \boxed{A_{32}} &amp; \boxed{A_{33}}
\end{bmatrix}_{128 \times 128}
\]</div><p></p><p>每个 <span class="math inline">\(\boxed{A_{ij}}\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(32 \times 32\)</span> 的子矩阵。</p>
<h3 id="22-分块的优势">2.2 分块的优势</h3>
<h4 id="数据复用">数据复用</h4>
<p>分块矩阵乘法的核心优势是<strong>数据复用</strong>：在计算单个输出块时，A 的行数据和 B 的列数据被多次复用。</p>
<p><strong>以计算 <span class="math inline">\(C_{00}\)</span> 为例</strong>（假设 <span class="math inline">\(C_{00}\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(32 \times 32\)</span> 的块，共 1024 个输出元素）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[C_{00} = A_{00} \times B_{00} + A_{01} \times B_{10} + A_{02} \times B_{20} + A_{03} \times B_{30}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>数据需求分析</strong>：</p>
<p>计算 <span class="math inline">\(32 \times 32 = 1024\)</span> 个输出元素需要：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
\text{数据} &amp; \text{范围} &amp; \text{元素数量} &amp; \text{说明} \\
\hline
\text{A 的行} &amp; \text{第 0 到 31 行} &amp; 32 \times 128 = 4096 &amp; \text{每行 128 个元素} \\
\text{B 的列} &amp; \text{第 0 到 31 列} &amp; 128 \times 32 = 4096 &amp; \text{每列 128 个元素}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>关键观察</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>A 的每个元素 <span class="math inline">\(a_{ik}\)</span> 会参与该行所有 32 个输出元素的计算：<span class="math inline">\(c_{i0}, c_{i1}, \ldots, c_{i31}\)</span></li>
<li>B 的每个元素 <span class="math inline">\(b_{kj}\)</span> 会参与该列所有 32 个输出元素的计算：<span class="math inline">\(c_{0j}, c_{1j}, \ldots, c_{31j}\)</span></li>
<li>即每个 A 元素被复用 32 次，每个 B 元素也被复用 32 次</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>内存访问对比</strong>（计算 1024 个输出元素）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}
\text{方式} &amp; \text{A 的访问次数} &amp; \text{B 的访问次数} &amp; \text{总访问次数} &amp; \text{说明} \\
\hline
\text{不分块} &amp; 1024 \times 128 = 131072 &amp; 1024 \times 128 = 131072 &amp; 262144 &amp; \text{每个输出元素独立读取 A 行和 B 列} \\
\text{分块} &amp; 4096 &amp; 4096 &amp; 8192 &amp; \text{A 和 B 的每个元素只加载 1 次到 Shared Memory}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>复用倍数</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{内存访问减少倍数} = \frac{262144}{8192} = 32 \text{ 倍}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>分块计算通过将 A 和 B 的数据缓存到 Shared Memory，使得每个数据元素只需加载一次，就能被 32 个输出元素复用，内存访问量减少 <strong>32 倍</strong>。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="缓存友好">缓存友好</h4>
<p><strong>内存层次结构</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{层次} &amp; \text{容量} &amp; \text{延迟} \\
\hline
\text{寄存器} &amp; \sim 256 \text{ KB} &amp; 1 \text{ cycle} \\
\text{L1 缓存} &amp; \sim 32 \text{ KB} &amp; \sim 4 \text{ cycles} \\
\text{L2 缓存} &amp; \sim 2 \text{ MB} &amp; \sim 40 \text{ cycles} \\
\text{全局内存} &amp; \sim 8 \text{ GB} &amp; \sim 400 \text{ cycles}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>分块策略</strong>：选择块大小使数据能放入高速缓存</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{块大小} \leq \text{缓存大小}
\]</div><p></p><p>例如：L1 缓存 32KB，FP32 数据：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{最大块元素数} = \frac{32 \times 1024}{4} = 8192 \text{ 元素}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{可选块大小} = 64 \times 64 = 4096 \text{ 元素（安全）}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="23-分块矩阵乘法示例">2.3 分块矩阵乘法示例</h3>
<h4 id="具体数值示例">具体数值示例</h4>
<p>计算 <span class="math inline">\(C = A \times B\)</span>，其中 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(4 \times 4\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(4 \times 4\)</span>，使用 <span class="math inline">\(2 \times 2\)</span> 分块：</p>
<p><strong>矩阵 A 分块</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[A = \begin{bmatrix}
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 1 &amp; 2 \\ 3 &amp; 4 \end{matrix}} &amp; 
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 5 &amp; 6 \\ 7 &amp; 8 \end{matrix}} \\
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 9 &amp; 10 \\ 11 &amp; 12 \end{matrix}} &amp; 
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 13 &amp; 14 \\ 15 &amp; 16 \end{matrix}}
\end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix}
A_{00} &amp; A_{01} \\
A_{10} &amp; A_{11}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>矩阵 B 分块</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[B = \begin{bmatrix}
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 1 &amp; 0 \\ 0 &amp; 1 \end{matrix}} &amp; 
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 2 &amp; 0 \\ 0 &amp; 2 \end{matrix}} \\
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 3 &amp; 0 \\ 0 &amp; 3 \end{matrix}} &amp; 
\boxed{\begin{matrix} 4 &amp; 0 \\ 0 &amp; 4 \end{matrix}}
\end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix}
B_{00} &amp; B_{01} \\
B_{10} &amp; B_{11}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>计算 <span class="math inline">\(C_{00}\)</span></strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[C_{00} = A_{00} \times B_{00} + A_{01} \times B_{10}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[= \begin{bmatrix} 1 &amp; 2 \\ 3 &amp; 4 \end{bmatrix} \times \begin{bmatrix} 1 &amp; 0 \\ 0 &amp; 1 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 5 &amp; 6 \\ 7 &amp; 8 \end{bmatrix} \times \begin{bmatrix} 3 &amp; 0 \\ 0 &amp; 3 \end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[= \begin{bmatrix} 1 &amp; 2 \\ 3 &amp; 4 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 15 &amp; 18 \\ 21 &amp; 24 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 16 &amp; 20 \\ 24 &amp; 28 \end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="分块计算流程图">分块计算流程图</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c}
\text{计算 } C_{00} \\
\downarrow \\
\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Step 1} &amp; \text{加载 } A_{00}, B_{00} \\
\hline
\text{Step 2} &amp; C_{00}^{(1)} = A_{00} \times B_{00} \\
\hline
\text{Step 3} &amp; \text{加载 } A_{01}, B_{10} \\
\hline
\text{Step 4} &amp; C_{00}^{(2)} = A_{01} \times B_{10} \\
\hline
\text{Step 5} &amp; C_{00} = C_{00}^{(1)} + C_{00}^{(2)} \\
\hline
\end{array}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="24-gpu-上的分块实现">2.4 GPU 上的分块实现</h3>
<h4 id="线程块映射">线程块映射</h4>
<p>在 GPU 上，每个线程块负责计算一个或多个输出块：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{GPU 概念} &amp; \text{矩阵分块对应} \\
\hline
\text{Workgroup / Thread Block} &amp; \text{计算一个或多个输出块 } C_{ij} \\
\text{Subgroup / Warp} &amp; \text{协作计算一个子块} \\
\text{Thread} &amp; \text{持有子块中的部分元素}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>映射示意</strong>（<span class="math inline">\(4 \times 4\)</span> 输出块，<span class="math inline">\(2 \times 2\)</span> 子块）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[C = \begin{bmatrix}
\color{red}{\boxed{C_{00}}} &amp; \color{blue}{\boxed{C_{01}}} \\
\color{green}{\boxed{C_{10}}} &amp; \color{orange}{\boxed{C_{11}}}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><ul>
<li>线程块 0（红色）：计算 <span class="math inline">\(C_{00}\)</span></li>
<li>线程块 1（蓝色）：计算 <span class="math inline">\(C_{01}\)</span></li>
<li>线程块 2（绿色）：计算 <span class="math inline">\(C_{10}\)</span></li>
<li>线程块 3（橙色）：计算 <span class="math inline">\(C_{11}\)</span></li>
</ul>
<h4 id="shared-memory-使用">Shared Memory 使用</h4>
<p>每个线程块使用 Shared Memory 缓存当前计算所需的数据块：</p>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// Shared Memory 声明
shared float A_tile[TILE_M][TILE_K];
shared float B_tile[TILE_K][TILE_N];

// 分块计算
for (int k = 0; k &lt; K; k += TILE_K) {
    // 协作加载 A 和 B 的当前块到 Shared Memory
    A_tile[ty][tx] = A[row * K + k + tx];
    B_tile[ty][tx] = B[(k + ty) * N + col];
    
    barrier();  // 同步
    
    // 计算当前块的贡献
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; TILE_K; i++) {
        sum += A_tile[ty][i] * B_tile[i][tx];
    }
    
    barrier();  // 同步
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="25-分块大小与硬件的关系">2.5 分块大小与硬件的关系</h3>
<p>分块大小的选择不是任意的，而是由硬件特性决定的。</p>
<h4 id="tensor-core-的固定尺寸">Tensor Core 的固定尺寸</h4>
<p>现代 GPU 配备了专门的矩阵计算单元（NVIDIA 称为 Tensor Core，Intel 称为 XMX），这些硬件单元在单周期内完成<strong>固定尺寸</strong>的矩阵乘加运算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{矩阵计算单元操作} = A_{M \times K} \times B_{K \times N} + C_{M \times N}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>常见矩阵计算单元尺寸</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}
M \times N \times K &amp; \text{A 尺寸} &amp; \text{B 尺寸} &amp; \text{C/D 尺寸} &amp; \text{硬件} \\
\hline
16 \times 8 \times 16 &amp; 16\times16 &amp; 16\times8 &amp; 16\times8 &amp; \text{NVIDIA Volta/Turing/Ampere} \\
16 \times 16 \times 16 &amp; 16\times16 &amp; 16\times16 &amp; 16\times16 &amp; \text{NVIDIA Ampere} \\
8 \times 8 \times 16 &amp; 8\times16 &amp; 16\times8 &amp; 8\times8 &amp; \text{Intel XMX}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="分块大小的约束">分块大小的约束</h4>
<p>由于矩阵计算单元的尺寸是固定的，分块大小必须满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{分块大小} = n \times \text{硬件单元尺寸}
\]</div><p></p><p>例如，如果硬件支持 16×8×16 的 Tensor Core 操作，那么分块大小应该是 16、8、16 的整数倍。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>分块大小选择的核心原则：<strong>匹配硬件矩阵计算单元的固定尺寸</strong>。这为后续 Cooperative Matrix 的设计奠定了基础——它封装了这些硬件细节，让开发者无需手动处理。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="26-从分块到-cooperative-matrix">2.6 从分块到 Cooperative Matrix</h3>
<p>理解矩阵分块后，Cooperative Matrix 的概念就自然清晰了：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{概念} &amp; \text{传统分块} &amp; \text{Cooperative Matrix} \\
\hline
\text{分块单位} &amp; \text{手动管理} &amp; \text{固定尺寸 (16×8 等)} \\
\text{数据存储} &amp; \text{Shared Memory} &amp; \text{线程寄存器（分布式）} \\
\text{计算单元} &amp; \text{CUDA Core} &amp; \text{Tensor Core} \\
\text{线程协作} &amp; \text{手动同步} &amp; \text{Subgroup 隐式同步} \\
\text{编程模型} &amp; \text{显式管理} &amp; \text{声明式 API}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>Cooperative Matrix 本质上是将矩阵分块技术与 Tensor Core 硬件结合，通过标准化的 API 让开发者无需关心底层细节。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="3-cooperative-matrix-原理">3. Cooperative Matrix 原理</h2>
<h3 id="31-什么是-cooperative-matrix">3.1 什么是 Cooperative Matrix</h3>
<p><strong>Cooperative Matrix（协作矩阵）</strong> 是 Vulkan 提供的一种特殊矩阵类型，其存储和计算分布在某个作用域（通常是 Subgroup）内的所有调用之间。这些调用协同工作，高效地执行矩阵乘法运算。</p>
<p>Cooperative Matrix 的核心特点：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>分布式存储</strong>：矩阵数据分布在 Subgroup 的所有线程中，每个线程只持有部分数据</li>
<li><strong>协同计算</strong>：所有线程共同参与矩阵运算，充分利用 Tensor Core 硬件加速</li>
<li><strong>中等尺寸</strong>：矩阵尺寸通常为 8×8、16×8、16×16 等，适合 Tensor Core 的计算单元</li>
<li><strong>透明优化</strong>：矩阵乘加操作由硬件（Tensor Core）执行，开发者无需手动管理线程间数据分配</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="311-cooperative-matrix-的意义">3.1.1 Cooperative Matrix 的意义</h4>
<p><strong>问题背景：传统 GPU 矩阵乘法的困境</strong></p>
<p>在传统 GPU 编程中，矩阵乘法的实现面临以下挑战：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>内存访问效率低</strong>：每个线程独立计算输出元素，导致大量重复的内存访问</li>
<li><strong>无法利用专用硬件</strong>：现代 GPU 配备了 Tensor Core 等矩阵计算专用单元，但传统编程模型无法直接使用</li>
<li><strong>优化复杂度高</strong>：需要精心设计 tiling、共享内存管理、bank conflict 避免等，代码复杂且难以移植</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Cooperative Matrix 的解决方案</strong></p>
<p>Cooperative Matrix 通过以下方式解决这些问题：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{问题} &amp; \text{传统方法} &amp; \text{Cooperative Matrix} \\
\hline
\text{内存访问} &amp; \text{每线程独立访问，重复读取} &amp; \text{协作加载，数据复用} \\
\text{硬件利用} &amp; \text{仅使用 CUDA/Shader Core} &amp; \text{直接使用 Tensor Core} \\
\text{编程复杂度} &amp; \text{手动 tiling、共享内存} &amp; \text{声明式编程，驱动优化} \\
\text{可移植性} &amp; \text{需针对不同 GPU 优化} &amp; \text{驱动处理硬件差异}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>性能提升</strong>：相比传统实现，Cooperative Matrix 可获得显著性能提升。根据 NVIDIA 的分析，Tensor Core 矩阵乘法可在 1 个周期内完成，而传统 FFMA 需要多个周期，具体加速比取决于矩阵尺寸和内存访问模式。</p>
<h4 id="312-矩阵乘法的数学定义">3.1.2 矩阵乘法的数学定义</h4>
<p>设矩阵乘法运算 <span class="math inline">\(D = A \times B + C\)</span>，其中：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[A \in \mathbb{R}^{M \times K}, \quad
B \in \mathbb{R}^{K \times N}, \quad
C, D \in \mathbb{R}^{M \times N}
\]</div><p></p><p>元素级计算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[D_{ij} = \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} A_{ik} \cdot B_{kj} + C_{ij}, \quad \forall i \in [0, M), j \in [0, N)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>计算复杂度分析</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{乘法次数} = M \times N \times K
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{加法次数} = M \times N \times K
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{总 FLOP} = 2 \times M \times N \times K
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="32-tensor-core-加速原理">3.2 Tensor Core 加速原理</h3>
<p>现代 GPU（如 NVIDIA RTX 系列、Intel Arc 系列）配备了专门的矩阵计算单元，称为 <strong>Tensor Core</strong>（NVIDIA）或 <strong>XMX</strong>（Intel）。这些硬件单元能够在单个时钟周期内完成小矩阵的乘加运算。</p>
<h4 id="321-tensor-core-的工作方式">3.2.1 Tensor Core 的工作方式</h4>
<p>Tensor Core 在单周期内完成小矩阵乘加运算。典型的 16×8×16 运算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{bmatrix}
d_{0,0} &amp; d_{0,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; d_{0,7} \\
d_{1,0} &amp; d_{1,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; d_{1,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
d_{15,0} &amp; d_{15,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; d_{15,7}
\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
a_{0,0} &amp; a_{0,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; a_{0,15} \\
a_{1,0} &amp; a_{1,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; a_{1,15} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
a_{15,0} &amp; a_{15,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; a_{15,15}
\end{bmatrix}
\times
\begin{bmatrix}
b_{0,0} &amp; b_{0,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; b_{0,7} \\
b_{1,0} &amp; b_{1,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; b_{1,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
b_{15,0} &amp; b_{15,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; b_{15,7}
\end{bmatrix}
+
\begin{bmatrix}
c_{0,0} &amp; c_{0,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; c_{0,7} \\
c_{1,0} &amp; c_{1,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; c_{1,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
c_{15,0} &amp; c_{15,1} &amp; \cdots &amp; c_{15,7}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>计算复杂度分析</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>乘法次数：<span class="math inline">\(M \times N \times K = 16 \times 8 \times 16 = 2048\)</span> 次</li>
<li>加法次数：<span class="math inline">\(M \times N \times K = 2048\)</span> 次</li>
<li>吞吐量：4096 FLOP/周期（Ampere 架构数据）</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>注意</strong>：Tensor Core 的"1周期"指的是吞吐量而非延迟。实际执行中，Tensor Core 操作有流水线延迟（通常 4-16 周期），但由于流水线设计，可以每个周期发射新的 Tensor Core 指令。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="322-支持的矩阵尺寸">3.2.2 支持的矩阵尺寸</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}
M \times N \times K &amp; \text{A 类型} &amp; \text{B 类型} &amp; \text{C/D 类型} &amp; \text{说明} \\
\hline
16 \times 8 \times 16 &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16/FP32} &amp; \text{最常用，NVIDIA GPU} \\
16 \times 8 \times 8 &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16/FP32} &amp; \text{较小尺寸} \\
8 \times 8 \times 16 &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16/FP32} &amp; \text{通用支持} \\
16 \times 16 \times 16 &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{FP16/FP32} &amp; \text{较大尺寸，高性能} \\
16 \times 8 \times 8 &amp; \text{BF16} &amp; \text{BF16} &amp; \text{FP32} &amp; \text{NVIDIA Ampere+}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="323-tensor-core-性能数据">3.2.3 Tensor Core 性能数据</h4>
<p>以下是 NVIDIA Ampere 架构的典型延迟数据（来源：NVIDIA 官方分析）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{操作类型} &amp; \text{周期数} &amp; \text{说明} \\
\hline
\text{全局内存访问} &amp; \sim 380 \text{ 周期} &amp; \text{访问 HBM/GDDR 显存} \\
\text{L2 缓存访问} &amp; \sim 200 \text{ 周期} &amp; \text{片上二级缓存} \\
\text{L1 缓存/共享内存} &amp; \sim 34 \text{ 周期} &amp; \text{每个 SM 的本地存储} \\
\text{FFMA（标量乘加）} &amp; 4 \text{ 周期} &amp; \text{CUDA Core 执行} \\
\text{Tensor Core 操作} &amp; 1 \text{ 周期吞吐} &amp; \text{流水线延迟 4-16 周期}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>性能对比示例</strong>（32×32 矩阵乘法）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{实现方式} &amp; \text{周期数} &amp; \text{计算方式} \\
\hline
\text{传统 CUDA Core} &amp; \sim 504 &amp; \text{全局内存 + 8次共享内存 + 8次FFMA} \\
\text{Tensor Core} &amp; \sim 235 &amp; \text{全局内存 + 1次共享内存 + 1次Tensor Core}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{加速比} = \frac{504}{235} \approx 2.1\times
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>实际加速比取决于矩阵尺寸、内存访问模式和 GPU 架构。大矩阵（如 GEMM）可获得更高加速比，因为 Tensor Core 的优势在计算密集型操作中更明显。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="33-与传统实现的对比">3.3 与传统实现的对比</h3>
<h4 id="331-传统标量实现">3.3.1 传统标量实现</h4>
<p>每个线程独立计算一个或多个输出元素：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[D_{ij} = \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} A_{ik} \cdot B_{kj} + C_{ij}
\]</div><p></p><p>线程 <span class="math inline">\(t\)</span> 计算的输出元素集合：<span class="math inline">\(\{(i, j) \mid t = f(i, j)\}\)</span></p>
<p><strong>传统线程计算示意</strong>（以 4×4 输出矩阵，2×2 微块为例）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[D = \begin{bmatrix}
\color{red}{d_{0,0}} &amp; \color{red}{d_{0,1}} &amp; \color{blue}{d_{0,2}} &amp; \color{blue}{d_{0,3}} \\
\color{red}{d_{1,0}} &amp; \color{red}{d_{1,1}} &amp; \color{blue}{d_{1,2}} &amp; \color{blue}{d_{1,3}} \\
\color{green}{d_{2,0}} &amp; \color{green}{d_{2,1}} &amp; \color{orange}{d_{2,2}} &amp; \color{orange}{d_{2,3}} \\
\color{green}{d_{3,0}} &amp; \color{green}{d_{3,1}} &amp; \color{orange}{d_{3,2}} &amp; \color{orange}{d_{3,3}}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p>不同颜色代表不同线程计算的 2×2 微块，每个线程独立完成：</p>
<ul>
<li>线程 0（红色）：<span class="math inline">\(d_{0,0}, d_{0,1}, d_{1,0}, d_{1,1}\)</span>（左上角 2×2 块）</li>
<li>线程 1（蓝色）：<span class="math inline">\(d_{0,2}, d_{0,3}, d_{1,2}, d_{1,3}\)</span>（右上角 2×2 块）</li>
<li>线程 2（绿色）：<span class="math inline">\(d_{2,0}, d_{2,1}, d_{3,0}, d_{3,1}\)</span>（左下角 2×2 块）</li>
<li>线程 3（橙色）：<span class="math inline">\(d_{2,2}, d_{2,3}, d_{3,2}, d_{3,3}\)</span>（右下角 2×2 块）</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>传统实现的问题</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{问题} &amp; \text{具体表现} \\
\hline
\text{内存访问效率低} &amp; \text{每个线程独立读取 A 的行和 B 的列，大量重复访问} \\
\text{无法利用 Tensor Core} &amp; \text{CUDA Core 一次只能执行一次乘加} \\
\text{计算密度低} &amp; \text{内存带宽成为瓶颈，计算单元利用率低} \\
\text{优化复杂} &amp; \text{需要手动实现 tiling、共享内存、避免 bank conflict}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="332-cooperative-matrix-实现">3.3.2 Cooperative Matrix 实现</h4>
<p>Subgroup 内所有线程协作完成矩阵块计算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\mathbf{D}_{M \times N} = \mathbf{A}_{M \times K} \times \mathbf{B}_{K \times N} + \mathbf{C}_{M \times N}
\]</div><p></p><p>每个线程持有矩阵的部分元素，协同完成计算。</p>
<p><strong>Cooperative Matrix 协作计算示意</strong>（以 16×8 输出矩阵为例）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[D = \begin{bmatrix}
d_{0,0} &amp; d_{0,1} &amp; d_{0,2} &amp; d_{0,3} &amp; d_{0,4} &amp; d_{0,5} &amp; d_{0,6} &amp; d_{0,7} \\
d_{1,0} &amp; d_{1,1} &amp; d_{1,2} &amp; d_{1,3} &amp; d_{1,4} &amp; d_{1,5} &amp; d_{1,6} &amp; d_{1,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots \\
d_{15,0} &amp; d_{15,1} &amp; d_{15,2} &amp; d_{15,3} &amp; d_{15,4} &amp; d_{15,5} &amp; d_{15,6} &amp; d_{15,7}
\end{bmatrix}_{16 \times 8}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>所有 32 线程协作计算此矩阵块</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>数据分布</strong>（每个线程持有 4 个元素）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{线程} &amp; \text{持有元素} \\
\hline
T_0 &amp; d_{0,0}, d_{0,1}, d_{0,2}, d_{0,3} \\
T_1 &amp; d_{0,4}, d_{0,5}, d_{0,6}, d_{0,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots \\
T_{31} &amp; d_{12,4}, d_{12,5}, d_{12,6}, d_{12,7}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>Cooperative Matrix 的优势</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{优势} &amp; \text{说明} \\
\hline
\text{内存合并访问} &amp; \text{所有线程协作加载，内存访问模式优化} \\
\text{Tensor Core 加速} &amp; \text{直接利用专用矩阵计算单元} \\
\text{高计算密度} &amp; \text{单次操作完成大量计算} \\
\text{代码简洁} &amp; \text{声明式编程，无需手动优化}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="333-性能对比">3.3.3 性能对比</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{特性} &amp; \text{传统实现} &amp; \text{Cooperative Matrix} \\
\hline
\text{计算单元} &amp; \text{CUDA Core / Shader Core} &amp; \text{Tensor Core / XMX} \\
\text{线程模型} &amp; \text{每个线程独立计算输出元素} &amp; \text{线程协作计算矩阵块} \\
\text{内存访问} &amp; \text{需精心设计避免 bank conflict} &amp; \text{数据布局由硬件处理，但仍需合理设计} \\
\text{代码复杂度} &amp; \text{高，需手动 tiling 和共享内存管理} &amp; \text{低，声明式编程} \\
\text{性能可移植性} &amp; \text{低，需针对不同 GPU 优化} &amp; \text{高，驱动处理硬件差异} \\
\text{计算吞吐量} &amp; \text{基准} &amp; \text{显著提升（取决于矩阵尺寸）}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="34-分布式存储模型">3.4 分布式存储模型</h3>
<h4 id="341-数据分布原理">3.4.1 数据分布原理</h4>
<p>Cooperative Matrix 的核心特性是<strong>数据分布在 Subgroup 的所有线程中</strong>。</p>
<p>设 Subgroup 大小为 <span class="math inline">\(S\)</span>，协作矩阵尺寸为 <span class="math inline">\(M \times N\)</span>。每个线程 <span class="math inline">\(t \in [0, S)\)</span> 持有的元素数量：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{elements}_t = \frac{M \times N}{S}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>典型配置</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c|c}
\text{矩阵尺寸} &amp; \text{元素总数} &amp; \text{Subgroup 大小} &amp; \text{每线程元素数} &amp; \text{典型 GPU} \\
\hline
16 \times 8 &amp; 128 &amp; 32 &amp; 4 &amp; \text{NVIDIA} \\
16 \times 16 &amp; 256 &amp; 32 &amp; 8 &amp; \text{NVIDIA} \\
8 \times 8 &amp; 64 &amp; 16 &amp; 4 &amp; \text{Intel} \\
8 \times 16 &amp; 128 &amp; 64 &amp; 2 &amp; \text{AMD}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="242-数据分布示意">2.4.2 数据分布示意</h4>
<p>以 16×8 矩阵、32 线程 Subgroup 为例：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{总元素数} = 16 \times 8 = 128
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{每线程元素数} = \frac{128}{32} = 4
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>矩阵元素分布示意</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{bmatrix}
\color{red}{e_0} &amp; \color{red}{e_1} &amp; \color{red}{e_2} &amp; \color{red}{e_3} &amp; \color{blue}{e_4} &amp; \color{blue}{e_5} &amp; \color{blue}{e_6} &amp; \color{blue}{e_7} \\
\color{green}{e_8} &amp; \color{green}{e_9} &amp; \color{green}{e_{10}} &amp; \color{green}{e_{11}} &amp; \color{orange}{e_{12}} &amp; \color{orange}{e_{13}} &amp; \color{orange}{e_{14}} &amp; \color{orange}{e_{15}} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots \\
\color{purple}{e_{120}} &amp; \color{purple}{e_{121}} &amp; \color{purple}{e_{122}} &amp; \color{purple}{e_{123}} &amp; \color{cyan}{e_{124}} &amp; \color{cyan}{e_{125}} &amp; \color{cyan}{e_{126}} &amp; \color{cyan}{e_{127}}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>线程与元素对应关系</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{线程 ID} &amp; \text{颜色} &amp; \text{持有元素} \\
\hline
T_0 &amp; \color{red}{\text{红}} &amp; e_0, e_1, e_2, e_3 \\
T_1 &amp; \color{blue}{\text{蓝}} &amp; e_4, e_5, e_6, e_7 \\
T_2 &amp; \color{green}{\text{绿}} &amp; e_8, e_9, e_{10}, e_{11} \\
T_3 &amp; \color{orange}{\text{橙}} &amp; e_{12}, e_{13}, e_{14}, e_{15} \\
\vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \vdots \\
T_{30} &amp; \color{purple}{\text{紫}} &amp; e_{120}, e_{121}, e_{122}, e_{123} \\
T_{31} &amp; \color{cyan}{\text{青}} &amp; e_{124}, e_{125}, e_{126}, e_{127}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>元素分配公式</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\text{Thread 0} &amp;\rightarrow \text{elem}[0, 1, 2, 3] \\
\text{Thread 1} &amp;\rightarrow \text{elem}[4, 5, 6, 7] \\
&amp;\vdots \\
\text{Thread 31} &amp;\rightarrow \text{elem}[124, 125, 126, 127]
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><blockquote>
<p>Vulkan 规范<strong>没有规定</strong>具体的元素分配方式，这是由硬件实现决定的。程序员不需要关心具体分配，硬件会自动处理。</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="243-尺寸匹配要求">2.4.3 尺寸匹配要求</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>矩阵尺寸必须与 Subgroup 大小匹配：<span class="math inline">\((M \times N) \mod S = 0\)</span></p>
<p>硬件会验证矩阵元素总数能被 Subgroup 大小整除。不匹配的组合会导致运行时错误或未定义行为。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="35-计算过程详解">3.5 计算过程详解</h3>
<h4 id="351-矩阵乘加的执行流程">3.5.1 矩阵乘加的执行流程</h4>
<p>Cooperative Matrix 执行 <span class="math inline">\(D = A \times B + C\)</span> 的过程：</p>
<p><strong>步骤 1：数据加载</strong></p>
<p>所有线程调用 <code>coopMatLoad</code>，从全局内存加载矩阵数据：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{coopMatLoad}(M, \text{buffer}, \text{offset}, \text{stride}, \text{layout})
\]</div><p></p><p>硬件根据 Tensor Core 的数据布局要求将数据分配到各线程的寄存器中。</p>
<p><strong>数据加载示意</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c}
\text{全局内存中的大矩阵 A (M × K)} \\[5pt]
\left[\begin{array}{ccccc}
\cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot \\
\cdot &amp; {\boxed{\begin{array}{ccc} a_{0,0} &amp; a_{0,1} &amp; \cdots \\ a_{1,0} &amp; a_{1,1} &amp; \cdots \\ \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots \end{array}}} &amp; \cdot \\
\cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot
\end{array}\right] \\[10pt]
\big\downarrow \\ext{coopMatLoad(offset, stride)} \\[5pt]
\big\downarrow \\
\underbrace{\begin{bmatrix} a_{0,0} &amp; a_{0,1} &amp; \cdots \\ a_{1,0} &amp; a_{1,1} &amp; \cdots \\ \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots \end{bmatrix}}_{\text{加载的子矩阵块}} \\[10pt]
\big\downarrow \quad \text{硬件按 Tensor Core 布局分配} \\[5pt]
\underbrace{\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
T_0 &amp; T_1 &amp; \cdots &amp; T_{31} \\
\hline
e_0..e_3 &amp; e_4..e_7 &amp; \cdots &amp; e_{124}..e_{127} \\
\hline
\end{array}}_{\text{数据分布到各线程寄存器}}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>步骤 2：矩阵乘加</strong></p>
<p>所有线程调用 <code>coopMatMulAdd</code>，Tensor Core 执行计算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[D = \text{coopMatMulAdd}(A, B, C)
\]</div><p></p><p>等价于：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d_{ij} = \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} a_{ik} \cdot b_{kj} + c_{ij}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>矩阵乘加示意</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{ccc}
\text{线程寄存器中的数据} &amp; \rightarrow &amp; \text{Tensor Core 计算} \\
\begin{array}{|c|}
\hline
T_0: a_0..a_3, b_0..b_3, c_0..c_3 \\
T_1: a_4..a_7, b_4..b_7, c_4..c_7 \\
\vdots \\
T_{31}: a_{124}..a_{127}, b_{124}..b_{127}, c_{124}..c_{127} \\
\hline
\end{array}
&amp;
\rightarrow
&amp;
\begin{array}{|c|}
\hline
\text{Tensor Core} \\
D = A \times B + C \\
\text{流水线执行} \\
\hline
\end{array}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>步骤 3：结果存储</strong></p>
<p>所有线程调用 <code>coopMatStore</code>，将结果写回全局内存：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{coopMatStore}(D, \text{buffer}, \text{offset}, \text{stride}, \text{layout})
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>结果存储示意</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c}
\underbrace{\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
T_0 &amp; T_1 &amp; \cdots &amp; T_{31} \\
\hline
d_0..d_3 &amp; d_4..d_7 &amp; \cdots &amp; d_{124}..d_{127} \\
\hline
\end{array}}_{\text{各线程持有结果的一部分}} \\[10pt]
\big\downarrow \\
\text{coopMatStore(offset, stride)} \\
\big\downarrow \\
\underbrace{\begin{bmatrix} d_{0,0} &amp; d_{0,1} &amp; \cdots \\ d_{1,0} &amp; d_{1,1} &amp; \cdots \\ \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots \end{bmatrix}}_{\text{写入的子矩阵块}} \\[10pt]
\big\downarrow \\[5pt]
\text{全局内存中的大矩阵 D (M × N)} \\[5pt]
\left[\begin{array}{ccccc}
\cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot \\
\cdot &amp; {\boxed{\begin{array}{ccc} d_{0,0} &amp; d_{0,1} &amp; \cdots \\ d_{1,0} &amp; d_{1,1} &amp; \cdots \\ \vdots &amp; \vdots &amp; \ddots \end{array}}} &amp; \cdot \\
\cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot &amp; \cdot
\end{array}\right]
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="352-uniform-control-flow-要求">3.5.2 Uniform Control Flow 要求</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>Subgroup 内的所有线程必须<strong>同时调用</strong> CM 函数，否则行为未定义！</p>
</blockquote>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\forall t \in [0, S): \text{thread}_t \text{ 调用 } \texttt{coopMatMulAdd}(A, B, C)
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>为什么需要 Uniform Control Flow？</strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong>矩阵存储分布在所有线程</strong>：数据分散在各线程中，需要所有线程参与</li>
<li><strong>协作计算</strong>：Tensor Core 需要所有线程协同工作</li>
<li><strong>硬件同步</strong>：这些函数在硬件层面隐式执行同步操作</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>正确示例</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// ✅ 正确：所有线程都调用
coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseA&gt; matA;
coopMatLoad(matA, buffer, offset, stride, layout);  // 所有 32 线程都调用
</code></pre>
<p><strong>错误示例</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// ❌ 错误：只有部分线程调用
if (gl_SubgroupInvocationID &lt; 16) {
    coopMatLoad(matA, buffer, offset, stride, layout);  // 未定义行为！
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="353-与普通变量赋值的对比">3.5.3 与普通变量赋值的对比</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{操作类型} &amp; \text{普通变量} &amp; \text{Cooperative Matrix} \\
\hline
\text{声明} &amp; \texttt{float x;} &amp; \texttt{coopmat&lt;&gt; m;} \\
&amp; \text{每个线程有独立的 x} &amp; \text{所有线程共享一个逻辑矩阵 m} \\
\text{赋值} &amp; \texttt{x = 1.0;} &amp; \texttt{m = coopmat&lt;&gt;(1.0);} \\
&amp; \text{每个线程的 x 都变成 1.0} &amp; \text{矩阵所有元素都变成 1.0} \\
\text{加载} &amp; \texttt{x = buffer[i];} &amp; \texttt{coopMatLoad(m, buffer, ...);} \\
&amp; \text{每个线程加载一个值} &amp; \text{所有线程协作加载整个矩阵} \\
\text{计算} &amp; \texttt{y = a * b + c;} &amp; \texttt{m = coopMatMulAdd(A, B, C);} \\
&amp; \text{每个线程独立计算} &amp; \text{所有线程协作计算（使用 Tensor Core）}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h2 id="4-vulkan-扩展介绍">4. Vulkan 扩展介绍</h2>
<h3 id="41-vk_khr_cooperative_matrix">4.1 VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix</h3>
<p><strong>VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix</strong> 是 Khronos 标准化的协作矩阵扩展，提供了跨厂商的标准接口。</p>
<p>扩展启用方式：</p>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// 在 GLSL shader 中启用扩展
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
</code></pre>
<p>扩展特性：</p>
<ul>
<li>支持查询设备支持的矩阵尺寸和类型组合</li>
<li>支持 Subgroup 和 Workgroup 作用域</li>
<li>支持多种数据类型：FP16、FP32、BF16、INT8、INT16、INT32</li>
<li>提供 Robust Buffer Access 选项</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="42-vk_nv_cooperative_matrix">4.2 VK_NV_cooperative_matrix</h3>
<p><strong>VK_NV_cooperative_matrix</strong> 是 NVIDIA 的厂商扩展，是 KHR 扩展的前身。</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{特性} &amp; \text{VK\_KHR\_cooperative\_matrix} &amp; \text{VK\_NV\_cooperative\_matrix} \\
\hline
\text{状态} &amp; \text{Khronos 标准} &amp; \text{NVIDIA 厂商扩展} \\
\text{矩阵类型} &amp; \texttt{coopmat&lt;&gt;} &amp; \texttt{fcoopmatNV&lt;&gt;} \\
\text{Use 参数} &amp; \text{显式指定（gl\_MatrixUseA/B/Accumulator）} &amp; \text{隐式（通过尺寸推断）} \\
\text{加载函数} &amp; \texttt{coopMatLoad()} &amp; \texttt{coopMatLoadNV()} \\
\text{存储函数} &amp; \texttt{coopMatStore()} &amp; \texttt{coopMatStoreNV()} \\
\text{乘加函数} &amp; \texttt{coopMatMulAdd()} &amp; \texttt{coopMatMulAddNV()}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>推荐</strong>：优先使用 VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix，除非需要兼容旧版驱动。</p>
<h3 id="43-api-查询方法">4.3 API 查询方法</h3>
<p>在使用 Cooperative Matrix 之前，必须查询设备支持的矩阵尺寸和类型组合：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">// 查询支持的 cooperative matrix 属性数量
uint32_t propertyCount = 0;
vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR(physicalDevice, &amp;propertyCount, nullptr);

// 分配空间并获取属性
std::vector&lt;VkCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR&gt; properties(propertyCount);
vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR(physicalDevice, &amp;propertyCount, properties.data());

// 遍历支持的矩阵配置
for (const auto&amp; prop : properties) {
    // prop.MSize, prop.NSize, prop.KSize - 矩阵尺寸
    // prop.AType, prop.BType, prop.CType, prop.ResultType - 数据类型
    // prop.scope - 作用域（Subgroup 或 Workgroup）
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>VkCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR 结构体</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">typedef struct VkCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR {
    VkStructureType    sType;           // 结构体类型
    void*              pNext;           // 扩展指针
    uint32_t           MSize;           // 矩阵 A 的行数，矩阵 C 的行数
    uint32_t           NSize;           // 矩阵 B 的列数，矩阵 C 的列数
    uint32_t           KSize;           // 矩阵 A 的列数，矩阵 B 的行数
    VkComponentTypeKHR AType;           // 矩阵 A 的元素类型
    VkComponentTypeKHR BType;           // 矩阵 B 的元素类型
    VkComponentTypeKHR CType;           // 矩阵 C 的元素类型
    VkComponentTypeKHR ResultType;      // 结果矩阵的元素类型
    VkBool32           saturatingAccumulation; // 是否饱和累加
    VkScopeKHR         scope;           // 作用域
} VkCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>VkComponentTypeKHR 支持的类型</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{枚举值} &amp; \text{对应类型} &amp; \text{说明} \\
\hline
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_FLOAT16\_KHR} &amp; \text{FP16} &amp; \text{半精度浮点数} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_FLOAT32\_KHR} &amp; \text{FP32} &amp; \text{单精度浮点数} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_BFLOAT16\_KHR} &amp; \text{BF16} &amp; \text{Brain Float16} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_SINT8\_KHR} &amp; \text{int8} &amp; \text{8位有符号整数} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_UINT8\_KHR} &amp; \text{uint8} &amp; \text{8位无符号整数} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_SINT16\_KHR} &amp; \text{int16} &amp; \text{16位有符号整数} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_UINT16\_KHR} &amp; \text{uint16} &amp; \text{16位无符号整数} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_SINT32\_KHR} &amp; \text{int32} &amp; \text{32位有符号整数} \\
\texttt{VK\_COMPONENT\_TYPE\_UINT32\_KHR} &amp; \text{uint32} &amp; \text{32位无符号整数}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>VkScopeKHR 作用域</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{枚举值} &amp; \text{说明} &amp; \text{使用场景} \\
\hline
\texttt{VK\_SCOPE\_SUBGROUP\_KHR} &amp; \text{Subgroup 作用域} &amp; \text{最常用，矩阵分布在单个 Subgroup 内} \\
\texttt{VK\_SCOPE\_WORKGROUP\_KHR} &amp; \text{Workgroup 作用域} &amp; \text{较大矩阵，需要跨 Subgroup 协作} \\
\texttt{VK\_SCOPE\_DEVICE\_KHR} &amp; \text{设备作用域} &amp; \text{跨 Workgroup（较少使用）} \\
\texttt{VK\_SCOPE\_QUEUE\_FAMILY\_KHR} &amp; \text{队列族作用域} &amp; \text{跨队列（较少使用）}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h2 id="5-shader-函数详解">5. Shader 函数详解</h2>
<h3 id="51-矩阵类型声明">5.1 矩阵类型声明</h3>
<h4 id="khr-扩展矩阵类型">KHR 扩展矩阵类型</h4>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// KHR 扩展的矩阵类型声明
coopmat&lt;ElementType, Scope, Rows, Cols, Use&gt; matrixName;

// 示例：声明一个 16×8 的矩阵 A（用于乘法左操作数）
coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseA&gt; matA;

// 示例：声明一个 8×8 的矩阵 B（用于乘法右操作数）
coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 8, 8, gl_MatrixUseB&gt; matB;

// 示例：声明一个 16×8 的累加器矩阵 C
coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; matC;
</code></pre>
<p>模板参数说明：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{参数} &amp; \text{类型} &amp; \text{说明} \\
\hline
\text{ElementType} &amp; \text{类型} &amp; \text{矩阵元素类型：float16\_t, float, bfloat16\_t, int8\_t, uint8\_t, int16\_t, uint16\_t, int32\_t, uint32\_t} \\
\text{Scope} &amp; \text{常量} &amp; \text{作用域：gl\_ScopeSubgroup, gl\_ScopeWorkgroup} \\
\text{Rows} &amp; \text{常量整数} &amp; \text{矩阵行数（必须是设备支持的尺寸）} \\
\text{Cols} &amp; \text{常量整数} &amp; \text{矩阵列数（必须是设备支持的尺寸）} \\
\text{Use} &amp; \text{常量} &amp; \text{矩阵用途：gl\_MatrixUseA, gl\_MatrixUseB, gl\_MatrixUseAccumulator}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="nv-扩展矩阵类型">NV 扩展矩阵类型</h4>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// NV 扩展的矩阵类型声明
fcoopmatNV&lt;BitWidth, Scope, Rows, Cols&gt; matrixName;

// 示例：FP16 矩阵（16位精度）
fcoopmatNV&lt;16, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8&gt; matA;

// 示例：FP32 矩阵（32位精度，用于累加器）
fcoopmatNV&lt;32, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8&gt; matC;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>BitWidth 精度说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>16</strong> - FP16（半精度浮点）</li>
<li><strong>32</strong> - FP32（单精度浮点）</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="52-matrix-use-类型">5.2 Matrix Use 类型</h3>
<p>Matrix Use 参数决定了矩阵在乘加运算中的角色：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\underbrace{A_{M \times K}}_{\text{MatrixA}} \times
\underbrace{B_{K \times N}}_{\text{MatrixB}} +
\underbrace{C_{M \times N}}_{\text{Accumulator}} =
\underbrace{D_{M \times N}}_{\text{Accumulator}}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>矩阵乘加示意</strong>（以 <span class="math inline">\(M=16, K=16, N=8\)</span> 为例）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\underbrace{\begin{bmatrix}
a_{0,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; a_{0,15} \\
\vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
a_{15,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; a_{15,15}
\end{bmatrix}}_{A: 16 \times 16}
\times
\underbrace{\begin{bmatrix}
b_{0,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; b_{0,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
b_{15,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; b_{15,7}
\end{bmatrix}}_{B: 16 \times 8}
+
\underbrace{\begin{bmatrix}
c_{0,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; c_{0,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
c_{15,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; c_{15,7}
\end{bmatrix}}_{C: 16 \times 8}
=
\underbrace{\begin{bmatrix}
d_{0,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; d_{0,7} \\
\vdots &amp; \ddots &amp; \vdots \\
d_{15,0} &amp; \cdots &amp; d_{15,7}
\end{bmatrix}}_{D: 16 \times 8}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>单个元素计算示意</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d_{ij} = \sum_{k=0}^{15} a_{ik} \cdot b_{kj} + c_{ij}
\]</div><p></p><p>例如 <span class="math inline">\(d_{0,0}\)</span> 的计算：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[d_{0,0} = a_{0,0} \cdot b_{0,0} + a_{0,1} \cdot b_{1,0} + \cdots + a_{0,15} \cdot b_{15,0} + c_{0,0}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
\text{Use 类型} &amp; \text{角色} &amp; \text{尺寸约束} &amp; \text{典型数据类型} \\
\hline
\texttt{gl\_MatrixUseA} &amp; \text{乘法左操作数} &amp; M \times K &amp; \text{FP16, BF16, INT8} \\
\texttt{gl\_MatrixUseB} &amp; \text{乘法右操作数} &amp; K \times N &amp; \text{FP16, BF16, INT8} \\
\texttt{gl\_MatrixUseAccumulator} &amp; \text{累加器（加法操作数和结果）} &amp; M \times N &amp; \text{FP16, FP32}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="53-scope-参数">5.3 Scope 参数</h3>
<p>Scope 参数定义了矩阵数据分布的范围：</p>
<p><strong>gl_ScopeSubgroup</strong>：矩阵分布在单个 Subgroup 内（最常用）</p>
<p><strong>gl_ScopeWorkgroup</strong>：矩阵分布在多个 Subgroup 间</p>
<h3 id="54-加载和存储函数">5.4 加载和存储函数</h3>
<h4 id="coopmatload--coopmatloadnv">coopMatLoad / coopMatLoadNV</h4>
<p>从内存加载数据到 Cooperative Matrix：</p>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// KHR 扩展语法
void coopMatLoad(
    out coopmat&lt;ElementType, Scope, M, N, Use&gt; matrix,  // 输出矩阵
    in uint[] buffer,                                   // 源缓冲区
    uint offset,                                        // 起始偏移（元素数）
    uint stride,                                        // 行/列步长
    uint layout                                         // 布局方式
);

// 示例：从 buffer 加载矩阵
coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseA&gt; matA;
coopMatLoad(matA, inputData, 0, K, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="coopmatstore--coopmatstorenv">coopMatStore / coopMatStoreNV</h4>
<p>将 Cooperative Matrix 数据存储到内存：</p>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// KHR 扩展语法
void coopMatStore(
    in coopmat&lt;ElementType, Scope, M, N, Use&gt; matrix,  // 输入矩阵
    out uint[] buffer,                                 // 目标缓冲区
    uint offset,                                       // 起始偏移
    uint stride,                                       // 行/列步长
    uint layout                                        // 布局方式
);

// 示例：存储结果矩阵
coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; result;
coopMatStore(result, outputData, 0, N, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="55-矩阵乘加函数">5.5 矩阵乘加函数</h3>
<p>执行矩阵乘加运算：<span class="math inline">\(D = A \times B + C\)</span></p>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// KHR 扩展语法
coopmat&lt;ResultType, Scope, M, N, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; coopMatMulAdd(
    coopmat&lt;AType, Scope, M, K, gl_MatrixUseA&gt; A,
    coopmat&lt;BType, Scope, K, N, gl_MatrixUseB&gt; B,
    coopmat&lt;CType, Scope, M, N, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; C
);

// 示例：完整的矩阵乘加
coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseA&gt; matA;
coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 8, 8, gl_MatrixUseB&gt; matB;
coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; matC;
coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; result;

// 初始化累加器
matC = coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt;(0.0f);

// 执行乘加
result = coopMatMulAdd(matA, matB, matC);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="56-布局参数">5.6 布局参数</h3>
<p><strong>内存布局</strong>：</p>
<h4 id="行主序gl_cooperativematrixlayoutrowmajor">行主序（<code>gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor</code>）</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{addr}(i, j) = \text{base} + i \times \text{stride} + j
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>内存排列示意</strong>（以 3×4 矩阵为例）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{bmatrix}
a_{0,0} &amp; a_{0,1} &amp; a_{0,2} &amp; a_{0,3} \\
a_{1,0} &amp; a_{1,1} &amp; a_{1,2} &amp; a_{1,3} \\
a_{2,0} &amp; a_{2,1} &amp; a_{2,2} &amp; a_{2,3}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>内存中的存储顺序</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[[a_{0,0}, a_{0,1}, a_{0,2}, a_{0,3}, \; a_{1,0}, a_{1,1}, a_{1,2}, a_{1,3}, \; a_{2,0}, a_{2,1}, a_{2,2}, a_{2,3}]
\]</div><p></p><p>即按行依次存储：第 0 行 → 第 1 行 → 第 2 行</p>
<h4 id="列主序gl_cooperativematrixlayoutcolumnmajor">列主序（<code>gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor</code>）</h4>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{addr}(i, j) = \text{base} + j \times \text{stride} + i
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>内存排列示意</strong>（以 3×4 矩阵为例）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{bmatrix}
a_{0,0} &amp; a_{0,1} &amp; a_{0,2} &amp; a_{0,3} \\
a_{1,0} &amp; a_{1,1} &amp; a_{1,2} &amp; a_{1,3} \\
a_{2,0} &amp; a_{2,1} &amp; a_{2,2} &amp; a_{2,3}
\end{bmatrix}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>内存中的存储顺序</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[[a_{0,0}, a_{1,0}, a_{2,0}, \; a_{0,1}, a_{1,1}, a_{2,1}, \; a_{0,2}, a_{1,2}, a_{2,2}, \; a_{0,3}, a_{1,3}, a_{2,3}]
\]</div><p></p><p>即按列依次存储：第 0 列 → 第 1 列 → 第 2 列 → 第 3 列</p>
<h3 id="57-其他相关函数">5.7 其他相关函数</h3>
<h4 id="矩阵初始化">矩阵初始化</h4>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">// 使用标量初始化所有元素
coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; mat(0.0f);

// 拷贝构造
coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 8, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; mat2 = mat1;
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>矩阵的行数 M 和列数 N 在类型声明时已确定，编译时已知，无需运行时查询。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="6-gemm-完整实现示例">6. GEMM 完整实现示例</h2>
<p>本章通过一个完整的 GEMM 示例项目 <code>cm_gemm_example</code>，讲解 Cooperative Matrix 的实际应用。该示例包含主机端代码和 Shader 代码，实现了带有 Double Buffer 优化的矩阵乘法。</p>
<h3 id="61-项目结构">6.1 项目结构</h3>
<pre><code>cm_gemm_example/
├── main.cpp          # 主机端代码
└── CMakeLists.txt    # 构建配置
</code></pre>
<p><strong>主要功能模块</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{模块} &amp; \text{文件} &amp; \text{功能} \\
\hline
\text{设备初始化} &amp; \text{main.cpp} &amp; \text{创建 Instance、Device、Queue} \\
\text{CM 属性查询} &amp; \text{main.cpp} &amp; \text{查询支持的矩阵尺寸} \\
\text{权重重排} &amp; \text{main.cpp} &amp; \text{预处理 B 矩阵} \\
\text{Pipeline 创建} &amp; \text{main.cpp} &amp; \text{编译 Shader、创建 Pipeline} \\
\text{GEMM 计算} &amp; \text{Shader} &amp; \text{执行矩阵乘法}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="62-主机端查询-cooperative-matrix-属性">6.2 主机端：查询 Cooperative Matrix 属性</h3>
<p>在使用 Cooperative Matrix 之前，必须查询设备支持的矩阵尺寸和类型组合：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void queryCooperativeMatrixProperties() {
    PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR = 
        (PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR)
        vkGetInstanceProcAddr(instance, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR");
    
    uint32_t propertyCount = 0;
    VK_CHECK(vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR(physicalDevice, &amp;propertyCount, nullptr));
    
    std::vector&lt;VkCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR&gt; properties(propertyCount);
    for (auto&amp; prop : properties) {
        prop.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COOPERATIVE_MATRIX_PROPERTIES_KHR;
        prop.pNext = nullptr;
    }
    
    VK_CHECK(vkGetPhysicalDeviceCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR(physicalDevice, &amp;propertyCount, properties.data()));
    
    for (const auto&amp; prop : properties) {
        if (prop.scope == VK_SCOPE_SUBGROUP_KHR) {
            std::cout &lt;&lt; "M=" &lt;&lt; prop.MSize &lt;&lt; ", N=" &lt;&lt; prop.NSize &lt;&lt; ", K=" &lt;&lt; prop.KSize
                      &lt;&lt; " (A: " &lt;&lt; prop.AType &lt;&lt; ", B: " &lt;&lt; prop.BType &lt;&lt; ", C: " &lt;&lt; prop.CType &lt;&lt; ")" &lt;&lt; std::endl;
            
            if (prop.AType == VK_COMPONENT_TYPE_FLOAT16_KHR &amp;&amp;
                prop.BType == VK_COMPONENT_TYPE_FLOAT16_KHR &amp;&amp;
                prop.CType == VK_COMPONENT_TYPE_FLOAT32_KHR) {
                selectedCM.M = prop.MSize;
                selectedCM.N = prop.NSize;
                selectedCM.K = prop.KSize;
            }
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>输出示例</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>Supported Cooperative Matrix configurations:
----------------------------------------
M=16, N=8, K=16 (A: FP16, B: FP16, C: FP16)
M=16, N=8, K=16 (A: FP16, B: FP16, C: FP32)
M=16, N=16, K=16 (A: FP16, B: FP16, C: FP16)
M=16, N=16, K=16 (A: FP16, B: FP16, C: FP32)

Selected configuration: M=16, N=16, K=16 (FP16 input, FP32 accumulate)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="63-主机端tile-尺寸计算">6.3 主机端：Tile 尺寸计算</h3>
<p>根据矩阵尺寸和 CM 尺寸，计算最优的 Tile 参数：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void calculateTileSizes() {
    TILE_M = std::min((M + selectedCM.M - 1) / selectedCM.M, 2u);
    TILE_N = std::min((N + selectedCM.N - 1) / selectedCM.N, 2u);
    TILE_K = std::min((K + selectedCM.K - 1) / selectedCM.K, 2u);
    
    std::cout &lt;&lt; "Tile sizes (for double buffer optimization):" &lt;&lt; std::endl;
    std::cout &lt;&lt; "  TILE_M = " &lt;&lt; TILE_M &lt;&lt; std::endl;
    std::cout &lt;&lt; "  TILE_N = " &lt;&lt; TILE_N &lt;&lt; std::endl;
    std::cout &lt;&lt; "  TILE_K = " &lt;&lt; TILE_K &lt;&lt; std::endl;
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Tile 参数含义</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
\text{TILE\_M} &amp;= \min\left(\left\lceil \frac{M}{M_{cm}} \right\rceil, 2\right) \\
\text{TILE\_N} &amp;= \min\left(\left\lceil \frac{N}{N_{cm}} \right\rceil, 2\right) \\
\text{TILE\_K} &amp;= \min\left(\left\lceil \frac{K}{K_{cm}} \right\rceil, 2\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>每个 Subgroup 处理 <span class="math inline">\(\text{TILE\_M} \times \text{TILE\_N}\)</span> 个 CM 块，每个 CM 块尺寸为 <span class="math inline">\(M_{cm} \times N_{cm}\)</span>。</p>
<h3 id="64-主机端b-矩阵权重重排">6.4 主机端：B 矩阵权重重排</h3>
<p>为了优化内存访问，B 矩阵需要预先重排：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void reorderBWeights() {
    uint32_t numWG_N = (N + TILE_N * selectedCM.N - 1) / (TILE_N * selectedCM.N);
    uint32_t numKTiles = (K + TILE_K * selectedCM.K - 1) / (TILE_K * selectedCM.K);
    uint32_t tileSizeB = TILE_K * selectedCM.K * TILE_N * selectedCM.N;
    
    hostB_reordered.resize(numWG_N * numKTiles * tileSizeB, 0.0f);
    
    for (uint32_t wgCol = 0; wgCol &lt; numWG_N; wgCol++) {
        for (uint32_t kt = 0; kt &lt; numKTiles; kt++) {
            uint32_t tileOffset = (wgCol * numKTiles + kt) * tileSizeB;
            
            for (uint32_t localK = 0; localK &lt; TILE_K * selectedCM.K; localK++) {
                for (uint32_t localN = 0; localN &lt; TILE_N * selectedCM.N; localN++) {
                    uint32_t globalK = kt * TILE_K * selectedCM.K + localK;
                    uint32_t globalN = wgCol * TILE_N * selectedCM.N + localN;
                    
                    uint32_t reorderedIdx = tileOffset + localK * (TILE_N * selectedCM.N) + localN;
                    
                    if (globalK &lt; K &amp;&amp; globalN &lt; N) {
                        hostB_reordered[reorderedIdx] = hostB[globalK * N + globalN];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>重排原理示意</strong>（以 <span class="math inline">\(K=4, N=8\)</span>，Tile 尺寸 <span class="math inline">\(2 \times 4\)</span> 为例）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{ccc}
\text{原始布局} &amp; &amp; \text{重排后布局} \\
\begin{bmatrix}
\color{red}{\boxed{b_{0,0} \cdots b_{0,3}}} &amp; \color{blue}{\boxed{b_{0,4} \cdots b_{0,7}}} \\
\color{red}{\boxed{b_{1,0} \cdots b_{1,3}}} &amp; \color{blue}{\boxed{b_{1,4} \cdots b_{1,7}}} \\
\color{green}{\boxed{b_{2,0} \cdots b_{2,3}}} &amp; \color{orange}{\boxed{b_{2,4} \cdots b_{2,7}}} \\
\color{green}{\boxed{b_{3,0} \cdots b_{3,3}}} &amp; \color{orange}{\boxed{b_{3,4} \cdots b_{3,7}}}
\end{bmatrix}
&amp;
\rightarrow
&amp;
\underbrace{\begin{bmatrix}
\boxed{\color{red}{\text{Tile}_{0,0}}} \\
\boxed{\color{green}{\text{Tile}_{1,0}}} \\
\boxed{\color{blue}{\text{Tile}_{0,1}}} \\
\boxed{\color{orange}{\text{Tile}_{1,1}}}
\end{bmatrix}}_{\text{按 K 方向连续存储}}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>重排过程</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>将原始矩阵划分为 <span class="math inline">\(K_{cm} \times N_{cm}\)</span> 的 tile</li>
<li>每个 tile 内的数据保持原有顺序</li>
<li>按 (WG, K方向) 重新排列 tile 的存储顺序</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>重排的优势</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{特性} &amp; \text{原始布局} &amp; \text{重排后布局} \\
\hline
\text{内存访问模式} &amp; \text{跨行跳跃访问} &amp; \text{连续块访问} \\
\text{缓存利用率} &amp; \text{低} &amp; \text{高} \\
\text{coopMatLoad 效率} &amp; \text{需要分散读取} &amp; \text{单次连续读取}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="65-主机端pipeline-创建与-specialization-constants">6.5 主机端：Pipeline 创建与 Specialization Constants</h3>
<p>使用 Specialization Constants 将运行时参数传递给 Shader：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void createPipeline() {
    std::string shaderSource = loadShaderSource();
    std::vector&lt;uint32_t&gt; spirv = compileShader(shaderSource);
    
    uint32_t numKTiles = (K + TILE_K * selectedCM.K - 1) / (TILE_K * selectedCM.K);
    uint32_t specData[8] = {
        selectedCM.M, selectedCM.N, selectedCM.K,
        subgroupSize,
        TILE_M, TILE_N, TILE_K,
        numKTiles
    };
    
    VkSpecializationMapEntry mapEntries[8] = {};
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; 8; i++) {
        mapEntries[i].constantID = i;
        mapEntries[i].offset = i * sizeof(uint32_t);
        mapEntries[i].size = sizeof(uint32_t);
    }
    
    VkSpecializationInfo specInfo = {};
    specInfo.mapEntryCount = 8;
    specInfo.pMapEntries = mapEntries;
    specInfo.dataSize = sizeof(specData);
    specInfo.pData = specData;
    
    pipelineInfo.stage.pSpecializationInfo = &amp;specInfo;
    pipelineInfo.stage.flags = VK_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_REQUIRE_FULL_SUBGROUPS_BIT;
    
    VK_CHECK(vkCreateComputePipelines(device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &amp;pipelineInfo, nullptr, &amp;pipeline));
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Specialization Constants 映射</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{ID} &amp; \text{Shader 常量} &amp; \text{主机端值} \\
\hline
0 &amp; \texttt{CM\_M} &amp; \texttt{selectedCM.M} \\
1 &amp; \texttt{CM\_N} &amp; \texttt{selectedCM.N} \\
2 &amp; \texttt{CM\_K} &amp; \texttt{selectedCM.K} \\
3 &amp; \texttt{subgroup\_size} &amp; \texttt{subgroupSize} \\
4 &amp; \texttt{TILE\_M} &amp; \texttt{TILE\_M} \\
5 &amp; \texttt{TILE\_N} &amp; \texttt{TILE\_N} \\
6 &amp; \texttt{TILE\_K} &amp; \texttt{TILE\_K} \\
7 &amp; \texttt{numKTiles} &amp; \texttt{numKTiles}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="66-shader常量定义与-shared-memory">6.6 Shader：常量定义与 Shared Memory</h3>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">#version 450
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_ballot : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_float16 : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint CM_M = 16;
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint CM_N = 16;
layout(constant_id = 2) const uint CM_K = 16;
layout(constant_id = 3) const uint subgroup_size = 32;
layout(constant_id = 4) const uint TILE_M = 2;
layout(constant_id = 5) const uint TILE_N = 2;
layout(constant_id = 6) const uint TILE_K = 2;
layout(constant_id = 7) const uint numKTiles = 1;

layout(local_size_x_id = 3) in;

layout(binding = 0) readonly buffer A_buffer { float16_t A_data[]; };
layout(binding = 1) readonly buffer B_buffer { float16_t B_data[]; };
layout(binding = 2) writeonly buffer C_buffer { float C_data[]; };

layout(push_constant) uniform PushConstants { uint M; uint N; uint K; } pc;

shared float16_t sharedA[2][TILE_M * CM_M * TILE_K * CM_K];
shared float16_t sharedB[2][TILE_K * CM_K * TILE_N * CM_N];
shared float sharedC[TILE_M * CM_M * TILE_N * CM_N];
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Shared Memory 结构</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c|c}
\text{变量} &amp; \text{尺寸} &amp; \text{用途} \\
\hline
\text{sharedA[2]} &amp; 2 \times \text{TILE\_M} \times M_{cm} \times \text{TILE\_K} \times K_{cm} &amp; \text{双缓冲 A 矩阵} \\
\text{sharedB[2]} &amp; 2 \times \text{TILE\_K} \times K_{cm} \times \text{TILE\_N} \times N_{cm} &amp; \text{双缓冲 B 矩阵} \\
\text{sharedC} &amp; \text{TILE\_M} \times M_{cm} \times \text{TILE\_N} \times N_{cm} &amp; \text{结果矩阵}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="67-shader数据加载函数">6.7 Shader：数据加载函数</h3>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">void loadTileA(uint tileIdx, uint wgRow, uint kStart) {
    const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
    const uint totalElements = TILE_M * CM_M * TILE_K * CM_K;
    for (uint i = lane; i &lt; totalElements; i += subgroup_size) {
        uint localM = i / (TILE_K * CM_K);
        uint localK = i % (TILE_K * CM_K);
        uint globalM = wgRow * TILE_M * CM_M + localM;
        uint globalK = kStart + localK;
        if (globalM &lt; pc.M &amp;&amp; globalK &lt; pc.K) {
            sharedA[tileIdx][i] = A_data[globalM * pc.K + globalK];
        } else {
            sharedA[tileIdx][i] = float16_t(0.0);
        }
    }
}

void loadTileB(uint tileIdx, uint wgCol, uint kt) {
    const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
    const uint tileSizeB = TILE_K * CM_K * TILE_N * CM_N;
    uint tileOffset = (wgCol * numKTiles + kt) * tileSizeB;
    for (uint i = lane; i &lt; tileSizeB; i += subgroup_size) {
        sharedB[tileIdx][i] = B_data[tileOffset + i];
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>加载策略</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>所有线程协作加载，每个线程加载 <code>totalElements / subgroupSize</code> 个元素</li>
<li>A 矩阵从全局内存按行主序加载</li>
<li>B 矩阵从预重排的缓冲区直接复制</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="68-shader主计算循环double-buffer">6.8 Shader：主计算循环（Double Buffer）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">void main() {
    const uint wgRow = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
    const uint wgCol = gl_WorkGroupID.y;
    const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;

    if (wgRow * TILE_M * CM_M &gt;= pc.M || wgCol * TILE_N * CM_N &gt;= pc.N) return;

    coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, CM_M, CM_N, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt; sum[TILE_M][TILE_N];
    [[unroll]] for (uint tm = 0; tm &lt; TILE_M; tm++) {
        [[unroll]] for (uint tn = 0; tn &lt; TILE_N; tn++) {
            sum[tm][tn] = coopmat&lt;float, gl_ScopeSubgroup, CM_M, CM_N, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator&gt;(0.f);
        }
    }

    const uint KTileSize = TILE_K * CM_K;

    loadTileA(0, wgRow, 0);
    loadTileB(0, wgCol, 0);
    barrier();

    for (uint kt = 0; kt &lt; numKTiles; kt++) {
        uint currentBuf = kt % 2;
        uint nextBuf = (kt + 1) % 2;

        [[unroll]] for (uint tk = 0; tk &lt; TILE_K; tk++) {
            [[unroll]] for (uint tm = 0; tm &lt; TILE_M; tm++) {
                [[unroll]] for (uint tn = 0; tn &lt; TILE_N; tn++) {
                    coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, CM_M, CM_K, gl_MatrixUseA&gt; matA;
                    coopmat&lt;float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, CM_K, CM_N, gl_MatrixUseB&gt; matB;

                    uint offsetA = (tm * CM_M) * (TILE_K * CM_K) + tk * CM_K;
                    uint offsetB = (tk * CM_K) * (TILE_N * CM_N) + tn * CM_N;
                    uint strideA = TILE_K * CM_K;
                    uint strideB = TILE_N * CM_N;

                    coopMatLoad(matA, sharedA[currentBuf], offsetA, strideA, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
                    coopMatLoad(matB, sharedB[currentBuf], offsetB, strideB, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);

                    sum[tm][tn] = coopMatMulAdd(matA, matB, sum[tm][tn]);
                }
            }
        }

        barrier();

        uint nextKt = kt + 1;
        if (nextKt &lt; numKTiles) {
            uint nextKStart = nextKt * KTileSize;
            loadTileA(nextBuf, wgRow, nextKStart);
            loadTileB(nextBuf, wgCol, nextKt);
        }

        barrier();
    }

    [[unroll]] for (uint tm = 0; tm &lt; TILE_M; tm++) {
        [[unroll]] for (uint tn = 0; tn &lt; TILE_N; tn++) {
            uint offsetC = (tm * CM_M) * (TILE_N * CM_N) + tn * CM_N;
            uint strideC = TILE_N * CM_N;
            coopMatStore(sum[tm][tn], sharedC, offsetC, strideC, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
        }
    }
    barrier();

    const uint totalC = TILE_M * CM_M * TILE_N * CM_N;
    for (uint i = lane; i &lt; totalC; i += subgroup_size) {
        uint localM = i / (TILE_N * CM_N);
        uint localN = i % (TILE_N * CM_N);
        uint globalM = wgRow * TILE_M * CM_M + localM;
        uint globalN = wgCol * TILE_N * CM_N + localN;
        if (globalM &lt; pc.M &amp;&amp; globalN &lt; pc.N) {
            C_data[globalM * pc.N + globalN] = sharedC[i];
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="69-double-buffer-优化详解">6.9 Double Buffer 优化详解</h3>
<h4 id="问题背景">问题背景</h4>
<p>传统实现中，数据加载和计算是串行执行的：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|cccccc}
\text{时间} &amp; t_0 &amp; t_1 &amp; t_2 &amp; t_3 &amp; t_4 &amp; t_5 \\
\hline
\text{加载} &amp; \boxed{L_0} &amp; &amp; \boxed{L_1} &amp; &amp; \boxed{L_2} &amp; \\
\text{计算} &amp; &amp; \boxed{C_0} &amp; &amp; \boxed{C_1} &amp; &amp; \boxed{C_2}
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p>总时间：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[T_{\text{serial}} = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (T_{\text{load},i} + T_{\text{compute},i})
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="double-buffer-原理">Double Buffer 原理</h4>
<p>使用两个缓冲区交替工作，实现加载与计算的重叠：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|cccccc}
\text{时间} &amp; t_0 &amp; t_1 &amp; t_2 &amp; t_3 &amp; t_4 &amp; t_5 \\
\hline
\text{Buffer 0} &amp; \boxed{L_0} &amp; \boxed{C_0} &amp; \boxed{L_2} &amp; \boxed{C_2} &amp; &amp; \\
\text{Buffer 1} &amp; &amp; \boxed{L_1} &amp; \boxed{C_1} &amp; \boxed{L_3} &amp; \boxed{C_3} &amp; 
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>加速比</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Speedup} = \frac{T_{\text{serial}}}{T_{\text{pipelined}}} \approx \frac{2(T_L + T_C)}{T_L + T_C} = 2
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="代码实现要点">代码实现要点</h4>
<pre><code class="language-glsl">for (uint kt = 0; kt &lt; numKTiles; kt++) {
    uint currentBuf = kt % 2;      // 当前计算使用的缓冲区
    uint nextBuf = (kt + 1) % 2;   // 下一块数据加载的缓冲区

    // 1. 从当前缓冲区计算
    coopMatLoad(matA, sharedA[currentBuf], ...);
    coopMatLoad(matB, sharedB[currentBuf], ...);
    sum[tm][tn] = coopMatMulAdd(matA, matB, sum[tm][tn]);

    barrier();

    // 2. 预加载下一块到另一个缓冲区
    if (nextKt &lt; numKTiles) {
        loadTileA(nextBuf, wgRow, nextKStart);
        loadTileB(nextBuf, wgCol, nextKt);
    }

    barrier();
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键点</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>使用 <code>currentBuf</code> 和 <code>nextBuf</code> 交替访问两个缓冲区</li>
<li><code>barrier()</code> 确保计算完成后再加载下一块</li>
<li>预加载与当前计算在时间上重叠</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="610-性能分析">6.10 性能分析</h3>
<p><strong>计算复杂度</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{FLOP} = 2 \times M \times N \times K
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>内存访问量</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Bytes} = M \times K \times 2 + K \times N \times 2 + M \times N \times 4
\]</div><p></p><p>（A 和 B 为 FP16，C 为 FP32）</p>
<p><strong>计算强度</strong>：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Arithmetic Intensity} = \frac{2 \times M \times N \times K}{M \times K \times 2 + K \times N \times 2 + M \times N \times 4} \quad \text{FLOP/Byte}
\]</div><p></p><p><strong>示例</strong>（<span class="math inline">\(M=N=K=256\)</span>）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{FLOP} = 2 \times 256^3 = 33,554,432 \approx 33.6 \text{ MFLOP}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Bytes} = 256^2 \times (2 + 2 + 4) = 524,288 \approx 0.5 \text{ MB}
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{Intensity} = \frac{33.6 \text{ MFLOP}}{0.5 \text{ MB}} = 64 \text{ FLOP/Byte}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="611-运行示例">6.11 运行示例</h3>
<pre><code>============================================
Vulkan Cooperative Matrix GEMM - Optimized
With Double Buffer Optimization
============================================
Validation layers enabled
Vulkan instance created

Available GPUs:
---------------

<h2 id="7-总结">7. 总结</h2>
<h3 id="核心公式汇总">核心公式汇总</h3>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{概念} &amp; \text{公式} \\
\hline
\text{矩阵乘法} &amp; D = A \times B + C \\
\text{元素计算} &amp; D_{ij} = \sum_k A_{ik} B_{kj} + C_{ij} \\
\text{每线程元素数} &amp; E = \frac{M \times N}{S} \\
\text{Workgroup 数量} &amp; WG = \lceil M/(M_{cm} Z_M W_M) \rceil \times \lceil N/(N_{cm} Z_N W_N) \rceil \\
\text{内存大小} &amp; \text{size} = B \times M_{cm} \times K_{cm} \times Z \times W \times K_K \\
\text{计算复杂度} &amp; \text{FLOP} = 2 \times M \times N \times K
\end{array}
\]</div><p></p><h3 id="性能要点">性能要点</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>数据布局优化</strong>：预处理权重，使内存访问连续</li>
<li><strong>计算密度</strong>：每个 Subgroup 处理足够大的矩阵块</li>
<li><strong>内存层次</strong>：利用 Local Memory 减少全局内存访问</li>
<li><strong>流水线</strong>：计算与内存传输重叠</li>
<li><strong>Uniform Control Flow</strong>：确保所有线程同时调用 CM 函数</li>
</ol>


</div>
